Attached is the USDCAD D1. The TL represents CP and the extended zone represents unused supply. Metatrader makes it difficult to make notes on charts. But the picture clearly shows a consolidation (large box zone) at the bottom towards demand. See price probing both extremes before deciding to push down to major demand. In which price rocketed pass the consolidation zone which tells us price used up supply in that area making the road clear till the unused supply zones represented by the extended blue zones.
